newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Southcorp plans Asia PET operations.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Southcorp plans Asia PET operations.

text.p: Southcorp Holdings Ltd said on Tuesday that it was close to finalising plans for two further PET recycled plastic operations in Asia, to be modelled on its current plant in Malaysia.
"In one case it will be a start-up plant, in the other case it will be added on to some existing capacity," chief executive Graham Kraehe told reporters after a business briefing.
Kraehe would not reveal where the new operations would be located, but said arrangements with customers were already in place and the company was awaiting government licence approvals.

He also would not give a value to the proposed investment but said generally such operations cost around A$10 million "plus or minus a bit depending on whether it has a partner in it, whether it is an add-on, whether it is a greenfield."
Kraehe told the briefing Southcorp was confident at this stage that 1996/97 would be a record year for the company.
